analyst_view.overall: Early view: Nice (6th) host Troyes a week after facing PSG; with no European football, Olivier Pantaloni can pick his strongest available side. Troyes (17th) have the league's weakest attack (7 goals) but have tightened up, with two clean sheets before a narrow 1-0 loss at PSG.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. I lean lower: Troyes score 0.7 a game, and their defence held PSG to one goal from 15 shots. Nice have 15 goals in 10 and should win, but 1-0 or 2-0 fits better than a high score.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners. I lean higher: Nice win 5.7 corners a game (4th) and should have plenty of the ball against a Troyes side that sits deep. Troyes won only one corner at PSG, so most will come from Nice.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards. I lean lower: Nice are among the cleanest sides in the league (9.9 fouls a game, 16th), and Troyes had only seven fouls at PSG. Three or four looks more likely than five.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.2 shots, with more for Troyes than Nice, which looks odd. I lean lower overall: Nice average 12.1 shots a game and Troyes managed only eight at PSG. Expect Nice to take most of the attempts and the total to land around 22.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. I lean lower: Nice average 4.0 on target and Troyes 3.3 (16th). Troyes keeper Konate was busy at PSG, but Nice do not have that firepower.
